limitations: Validated only on Linux x86-64 (WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04), CPython 3.11.17, CPU JAX; macOS and GPU not tested.
python3.11 is not on PATH here; the documented 'uv venv'/'uv pip install' alternatives were used, not 'python3.11 -m venv' + pip.
Installation was served from the local uv cache (incl. the pinned diffres git commit); a cold-cache network install was not exercised.
Artifact comparisons reuse the existing upstream reference files in notebooks/ and the existing integration criteria; small sizes only, not the paper's 100-seed tables.

heavy.sh reported gpu_used_after=44MiB after the acceptance run (0 before); JAX was forced to CPU (JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty) and the value stayed 44MiB before/after the next job, so it is attributed to another process.
Server-process /proc maps listing omitted files under the space-containing extraction path (parser limitation); module-origin evidence comes from the in-process import check.
